title: SSL/TLS Certificates: Compensation Basis for Late Issuance
content:
**Product:** Harborline Customer Accounts, for subscriptions under SSL/TLS Certificates

**Rule.** The compensation basis of the late-issuance goodwill depends on how late the certificate was: where the days the issuance was late are 14 or more, the basis is the subscription's monthly value, which is its new-subscription charge divided by twelve times the years that charge covered, for each started week of those days; where they are 7 or more but fewer than 14, the basis is one monthly value; where they are fewer than 7, the basis is the subscription's daily value times those days.

A started week counts in full and is seven days, so 14 late days are two started weeks and 15 late days are three.

**Hypothetical subscription:** a two-year new-subscription charge of $163.20 gives a monthly value of $163.20 divided by 24, $6.80.

| Days the issuance was late | Basis |
|---|---|
| 6 | daily value times 6 |
| 7 | $6.80 |
| 13 | $6.80 |
| 14 | $13.60 |
| 15 | $20.40 |
